subject: [PATCH v9 06/32] s390: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds helpers for managing PMD-mapped anonymous THPs on the s390 architecture, specifically for handling swap operations. It introduces a new bit in the RSTE (Region/Segment Table Entry) layout to mark swap entries as exclusive, allowing them to survive across swap round-trips. The patch also updates the pgtable.h file to include these new helpers and modify the RSTE swap layout documentation.
